title: Arrival in Zurich
content: Landed in Zurich and strolled along the Limmat River. First impressions: clean, scenic, and very efficient!

title: Hiking the Matterhorn
content: Challenging but unforgettable hike. Snow-capped peaks and crisp air made this a highlight.

title: Shibuya Scramble
content: Got lost in the organized chaos of Tokyo. Tried ramen at Ichiran and saw the crossing lit up at night.

title: Desert Under the Stars
content: Camped in the Sahara. The sunset over the dunes was surreal, and the stars were the brightest I’ve ever seen.

title: Patagonian Sunrise
content: Woke up early to catch the sunrise over Torres del Paine. The silence and color were unforgettable.

title: Amalfi Dreaming
content: Cliffside views, lemon groves, and gelato by the sea. Italy never disappoints.
